overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Rothschild Administrative Committee was scheduled to meet on November 13, 2026, to consider a motion to adjourn to closed session for discussion of employee performance evaluations under Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85(1)(c), followed by potential action upon reconvening in open session.
presiding: Elizabeth Felkner, Presiding Officer or Designee

agenda.item: Consideration of Motion to Adjourn to Closed Session Pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85(1)(c) to Discuss Employee Performance Evaluation
Motion to Reconvene into Open Session and Take Action Regarding Items Discussed in Closed Session

discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to consider a motion to adjourn into closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes Section 19.85(1)(c) to discuss employee performance evaluation matters. This closed session was set to address employment-related personnel matters over which the Village of Rothschild exercises jurisdiction and responsibility.

actionItems: scheduled to vote on motion to adjourn to closed session
expected to reconvene in open session and take action on matters discussed in closed session
